fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. A 2-Inch Photo * 2. Scanned Copy of the first page of Passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included(Photocopy of valid passport identification page. Passport must be an ordinary passport and be valid for at least six months. Applicants currently residing in China must include a copy of the page containing a valid visa or residence permit.) * 3. Resume 1. The Education Background must start from Senior High School until now. 2. If you have worked or once worked, please fill out the Work Experience, and provide the Job Letter (certificate of employment). 3. If you have not worked after graduating from school, fill in the duration and "no working" Note: If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. If you can not find a translation organization, please contact CUCAS. You can download a template or sample from here . 4. HSK Certificate Non-essential documents.If you are have, you can provide HSK grade 4 certificate for Bachelor Degree Program. * 5. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificates should be notarized; If not in Chinese or English, graduation certificates should be translated into Chinese or English. If the applicant is a registered student, he/she should also submit his/her study certificate or transfer certificate issued by his/her school. * 6. High school academic transcript Transcripts in languages other than Chinese and English must be accompanied by notarized Chinese or English translations. * 7. Non-criminal Record Certificate (Generally, it is valid for 3 or 6 months) It must be issued by your local police station with official stamp. If not in English or Chinese, it should be translated into English or Chinese. * 8. Physical Examination Form(only valid for 6 months) Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Bank statement Degree students must provide a bank statement of no less than 40,000 RMB. 10. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good Conduct Provided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate. You can download a template or sample from here . * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements High school degree, 16-50 years old, in good health. HSK3 with a score of 180 or above, or passing the Chinese Entrance Examination.
